WITH channel_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    orders.orderbase,
    AVG(fees.feerate) AS avg_fee_rate
  FROM fees
  JOIN orders ON fees.orderslink = orders.recordvault
  WHERE fees.feerate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY orders.orderbase
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS bench_rate
  FROM channel_avgs
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT 
    ca.avg_fee_rate,
    ca.avg_fee_rate - b.bench_rate AS excess
  FROM channel_avgs ca
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE ca.avg_fee_rate > b.bench_rate
)
SELECT 
  AVG(avg_fee_rate) AS mean_avg_fee_rates,
  AVG(excess) AS mean_excess
FROM above_benchmark;

assumptions.assumption: NULL feerate values are excluded from channel averages using SQL's AVG() function, which ignores NULLs by default
The benchmark is an unweighted arithmetic mean of all channel averages, treating each orderbase channel equally regardless of transaction volume
